references.text: The parallel account of Israel's arrival at Elim with twelve springs and seventy palm trees, where they camped by the water.
The account of Mara, the place Israel left before coming to Elim, where the water was bitter.
Israel's departure from Elim and continuation of the journey toward the Wilderness of Sinai.
The previous stop on the route - Mara, mentioned as the starting point in this verse.
The next stop on the route - the departure from Elim toward the Sea of Reeds.
